info.name: Authentication ACH Returns Payment Methods API

params.name: billable_merchant_id
params.description:
The unique merchant identifier for the billable merchant, utilized in processes such as BIN Lookup and Card Account Updater.

Prefix is "mid" in production and "sbx_mid" in sandbox.

params.name: fingerprint
params.description: The unique identifier of a payment method across all platform merchants.

params.name: status
params.description:
One or more payment method statuses to filter by. Provide parameter multiple times to filter by multiple payin status types.

`ACTIVE` `CANCELED` `CREATED` `DEACTIVATED` `FAILED` `PRESENTING` `REPLACED`

params.name: updated_at.start
params.description: Last updated on or after in UTC RFC 3339 format.

params.name: updated_at.end
params.description: Last updated on or before in UTC RFC 3339 format.

params.name: replaced_at.start
params.description: Replaced on or after in UTC RFC 3339 format.

params.name: replaced_at.end
params.description: Replaced on or before in UTC RFC 3339 format.

params.name: replacement_disabled.start
params.description: Replacement disabled on or after in UTC RFC 3339 format.

params.name: replacement_disabled.end
params.description: Replacement disabled on or before in UTC RFC 3339 format.

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Optional value by which to sort the result set. Default sort by is created_at.

items.docs: Query a list of payment methods given optional search criteria.

Create a saved payment method.

To duplicate a saved payment method, set the payment_method_id of the payment method to be duplicated. Billing contact and metadata is not persisted from the duplicated payment method and must be defined on the [Payment Method Config](ref:create_payment_method_config) or on the request. Only the stored sensitive payment method details (i.e full card or bank account number) will persist to the duplicated payment method.

info.name: Create payin from stored payment method

items.docs: Create and process a payin using a payin configuration and a stored payment method. The merchant status must be `ACTIVE` to create a payin.

params.name: payment_method_id
params.description:
The unique payment method identifier. 

Prefix is "mtd" in production and "sbx_mtd" in sandbox.

items.docs: Deactivate payment method. Deactivated payment methods cannot be used to process payins. The payment method status must be `ACTIVE` to be deactivated.
